title: Decawork
description_en: Control your company's internal AI agents and tools. Decawork is how IT teams take employee-built AI agents live and control every one of them from one place. An employee builds an agent on Claude Code, Codex, or any vibecoding tool; we take it in, put it on company accounts, and run it as a company asset. From there, IT team manages the agent like an employee: access, oversight, retirement.

title: coolplugz
description_en: A Claude orchestrator that saves developers loads of time. An orchestration layer that guides Claude Code to deliver your coding tasks without requiring your constant supervision. It fetches your context from Jira, Github, Notion and Slack, writes your prompts and verifies that claude code completes tasks correctly.

title: PaymentKit
description_en: Billing that survives a processor shutdown. PaymentKit is a multi-processor billing platform for SaaS and e-commerce. It routes payments across processors, vaults tokens independently, and keeps subscriptions billing even if a MID gets shut down. No code to launch, full API when you need it.
description_zh: PaymentKit解决高风险商户的支付连续性问题。当Stripe/Adyen等支付处理器关闭商户账号(MID shutdown)时，传统方案会导致订阅业务完全中断。PaymentKit通过：①独立token vault存储支付凭证 ②智能路由引擎跨多个处理器分发交易 ③自动故障转移机制，确保即使主处理器下线，订阅仍能正常扣款。产品提供no-code快速接入和完整API两种模式。目标用户是SaaS和电商企业，特别是那些面临高拒付率、监管审查或业务模式敏感的商户。Product Hunt获得432票高人气，说明市场对支付韧性有强烈需求。

title: Offloop
description_en: A shared workspace where people and AI agents get work done. Offloop is a shared workspace where teammates and AI agents plan, execute, and track multi-step work together. Channels keep conversations and decisions visible to the whole team. Flow gives every stage a clear owner and brings people in for key decisions, so work keeps moving across handoffs instead of restarting in a new AI chat. Offloop officially launches on August 24.
description_zh: Offloop是一个为人类团队成员和AI agents设计的共享工作空间。核心解决的问题是：传统AI对话工具中，工作流程在不同聊天窗口间切换时会丢失上下文，导致重复劳动。产品通过两个核心机制运作：①Channels保持对话和决策对全团队可见，建立共享记忆；②Flow为每个工作阶段分配明确owner，在关键决策点引入人类参与，确保工作在人机交接时不中断。目标用户是需要多步骤协作的知识工作团队。已有成果：PH获得302票高人气，4.0评分，2026年8月24日正式发布，显示产品已进入市场验证阶段。

title: Flare
description_en: The graph-first IDE and interactive map for agentic coding. Most agentic coding tools hand you a chat log. Flare hands you the map. Every file is a node, every import an edge, with a real terminal underneath where you run claude, codex or opencode. The graph updates live as the agent edits, attributes every write to whoever made it, and pulls you in when it rewrites something the rest of the app imports. Change bursts snapshot to local history you can diff and revert. Agents take work from a board over MCP. Your machine. No account. MIT licensed.
description_zh: Flare是一个革新性的Agent编程IDE，核心创新是将代码库结构化为交互式图谱：每个文件是节点，每个import是边。与传统Agent工具只给聊天记录不同，Flare提供实时可视化地图，底层集成真实终端可运行Claude/Codex/OpenCode等Agent。当Agent编辑代码时图谱实时更新，每次修改都标注作者归属，当Agent重写被其他模块依赖的代码时会主动提醒开发者。变更以burst形式快照到本地历史，支持diff和回滚。Agent通过MCP协议从看板获取任务。完全本地运行，无需账号，MIT开源协议。目标用户是需要与多个AI Agent协作编程的开发者，解决Agent黑盒操作和代码依赖追踪难题。

title: Trama
description_en: Create macOS native automations using plain language. Zapier and Shortcuts make you think like a programmer: blocks, flows, conditions. Trama removes that layer. Press Cmd+Option+X, describe what you repeat in your own words, and it runs in the background. What is different: · Your language, not just English · Native Mac reach: AppleScript, shell, OCR, screen awareness · It notices what you repeat and suggests the automation · If it breaks, AI explains the error and fixes it in one tap · Your key: Claude, GPT, Gemini, Groq.

title: Cortex by SKYNETLAB
description_en: The memory layer that decides what's worth remembering. Hosted semantic memory your AI connects to over MCP. Every write passes a quality gate (~80% rejected as redundant in production), facts become typed claims, contradictions are tracked instead of overwritten, and answers cite their sources. 2-minute setup with Claude, works with any MCP client. 30-day free trial, no card. Plans from €0.99/month. EU infrastructure, patent-pending engine. Built solo in Bergamo, Italy.

title: Codity
description_en: Radically Different Codebase Intelligence. One connected platform where every review, commit, ticket, security finding, and production outage continuously improves a shared, persistent understanding of your codebase. Most products analyze each task in isolation. Their context disappears when the session ends. Codity’s intelligence compounds over time. Codity doesn’t simply observe your software. It learns from its entire lifecycle and turns that knowledge into better decisions every day.

title: Optics-QA
description_en: One run: bug found, ticket written, fix prompt ready. Error tracking, session replay, uptime monitoring, recorded user flows that replay against your real app, a graded pentest, load testing, DDoS drills, SOC2 readiness and a Linear-quality issue board. One product, not nine tabs. A failure gets captured, grouped, written up and assigned before anyone opens a ticket, and every proof run ends in a shareable report you can send to a client or an auditor.

title: session-indexer
description_en: Semantic search over your own Claude Code session history. Per-project semantic search over your Claude Code session history — not a shared or centralized memory store. Indexes JSONL transcripts into a local SQLite file, retrieves via bge-m3 embeddings (Ollama) with automatic FTS5 BM25 fallback, and auto-injects relevant past context at session start. Companion to session-end: session-end gives "where I left off," session-indexer gives "what we decided" — same Stop/SessionStart hooks. Apache 2.0, 75 passing tests, go install and nothing to deploy.

title: ChatGPT Ad Library
description_en: See every ad running inside ChatGPT. Spy on Competitors ads and optimise your CTR.
